usefulness.example: Evaluate C submissions using the same instructor rules.
Show an input that produces an incorrect answer.
usefulness.benefit: Students can reproduce and investigate failures.

usefulness.example: Review similar programs when comparison files exist.

limitations.example: A program passes supplied tests but fails an unseen input.
A simple estimator misses relationships between loops.
Two independent short programs look almost identical.
limitations.mitigation: Review matches before reaching a conclusion.

limitations.example: A sanitizer timeout leaves later tests unexecuted.
limitations.mitigation: Investigate the timeout and rerun the checks.
